annotations.title: Scan Text for MCP Poisoning & Unicode Smuggling

description: Scan untrusted runtime text, MCP tool descriptions, or prompt payloads for invisible zero-width/bidirectional Unicode smuggling (`U+200B`..`U+202E`), prompt-injection override directives, and exposed 64-byte Solana keypairs or private keys. Purely read-only static text inspection with zero code execution (5 free calls/hour per IP or unlimited with X-API-Key). Returns JSON with `verdict` (`ALLOW`, `WARN`, `BLOCK`), `risk_score` (0-100), and matched `findings`. Use this tool for runtime prompt and tool-description hygiene; use `audit_solidity_or_mcp` for full Solidity smart contract or JSON config file audits.

text.description: Raw untrusted text, MCP tool description, or prompt string to scan for invisible Unicode characters, prompt injection, and leaked secrets.

name: check_mcp_poisoning
